patthana17.10:1.1: kusalaṃ sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. dvemūlāni cha.
patthana17.10:2.1: abyākataṃ asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.10:3.1: abyākataṃ nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na abyākato na nevasekkhānāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. kusalattika parittattike nakusalattika naparittattikaṃ
